title: MAJUNG Studio QA relay to Cloudflare backend MCP 2026-07-28 integration
scope: Isolated two-Worker QA within Cloudflare. The existing owner-private MAJUNG Studio/Sites application and ChatGPT registration were not changed.

fixes.issue: Studio sent legacy headerless JSON-RPC to modern 2026-07-28 backend
fixes.resolution: MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Method, Mcp-Name, _meta clientCapabilities, clientInfo; modern resultType complete validation. Legacy Asset Factory call path untouched.
Replace with redirect:'manual' and explicitly reject all 300-399 responses; preserves anti-redirect behavior.

fixes.issue: Worker-to-Worker fetch on same workers.dev zone yielded edge 404 (preview and default QA backend)
fixes.resolution: Only isolated QA relay Worker set global_fetch_strictly_public compatibility flag, to emulate external public fetch. Production Sites caller will not inherit this flag. Cloudflare service binding is an alternative for same-account Workers.

fixes.issue: Studio /mcp inbound used pre-2026 response format
fixes.resolution: Add modern server/discover, list/call result envelopes, mirrored header/Origin checks, protocol version errors while retaining older headerless initialize/list behavior for previously installed Sites clients.

cloudflare.test_bearers: Synthetic test-only values; no real production credentials or paid provider keys
